verdict.rationale: Any product with public web documentation could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies to INPI. The evidence pack contains only human-oriented French procedural pages (trademark, patent and design filing guides) and no llms.txt, Markdown docs or agent-oriented documentation. The probe shows data.inpi.fr returning 403 to keyless agents, which says nothing in favor of agent-readable docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
